office_does: The assessor values all taxable real and personal property in the county every year so property taxes are spread fairly among owners.
race_blurb: A rematch of 2025, when Drew Jenkins won the rest of a vacated term with 57% over Justin Moriarty; Jenkins also led the August primary 1,052 to 619. Both are state-accredited appraisers.

candidates.summary: The sitting assessor, elected in 2025, after seven years as an appraiser in the office and 13 years appraising in Chicago.
highlights: Won the 2025 election for the rest of the term, 57.32% to 42.52% [S5]
Appraiser in the Assessor's Office 2016-2023; 13 years as a Chicago residential appraiser [S3]
Says he aims to help people understand the valuation process [S3]

experience.basis: Sitting assessor with a decade-plus documented appraisal record in the office and in Chicago, accredited since 2018.

candidates.summary: A DOR-accredited appraiser since 2024 who lost the 2025 race and campaigns on fresh ideas, better tools and an open-door policy.
highlights: Said in 2025 he was working in the Assessor's Office [S3]
Promises "fresh ideas, better tools" and an open-door policy on tax questions [S4]

experience.basis: Challenger accredited only since 2024 who runs on "fresh ideas, better tools" against the incumbent, while citing appraisal credentials of his own.
